operating_rules: Keep Discord usable if Carl-bot is offline.
No routine @everyone pings; use opt-in notification roles.
Do not store rights, payment, contract, unreleased-master, credential, or entitlement data in public Discord.
One automation owner per routine signal to prevent duplicate posts.
Use slash commands first; legacy prefixes are transitional only because Carl-bot is retiring prefix commands.
Do not purge official event threads, support history, moderation evidence, rights/submission records, or automation audit logs.
Level roles and voice-linked roles are recognition/presence signals only and grant no authority or private access.
All public-facing automation must preserve Reset Inner Circle access and the resetinnercircle.com gateway.

command_migration.policy: Do not build new workflows that depend on prefixes. Existing event tags should be callable through Carl's slash/tag surface where supported; retain legacy aliases only during transition.
command_migration.leadership_event_launch: Use a single slash/tag launcher for Power Hour and event gates; delete invocation when supported so leadership channels stay clean.

levels_xp.purpose: Ambient participation progression only; verified achievement remains separate.
levels_xp.anti_farm: Use cooldowns and exclude bot/spam channels from XP where Carl supports it.
levels_xp.level_up_channel: activity-reports or a dedicated low-noise recognition channel
levels_xp.boundary: Do not imply RMS representation, licensing approval, professional clearance, employment, or publishing status.

channels.message: Code of Law acceptance + next-step onboarding link
What is live now + how to enter current activation
Entry gate rules, all-engage-with-all standard, thread instructions, two-minute gate reminder
Listening-room etiquette, original/cleared music rule, quick-entry / stage routing
How to submit a suggestion and where decisions are logged

sticky_messages.rule: One sticky per high-value channel; no duplicate banners or clutter.

timed_reaction_roles.note: Role expiry cleans up temporary event identity; the two-minute entry gate still requires the existing gate-close workflow.

drama_watcher.destination: automation-alerts or a dedicated private mod-watch channel
drama_watcher.policy: Private only. Route automod incidents for human review; no public shaming.

personalize.avatar: Use the exact approved RS/Reset Inner Circle mark with no duplicate logo treatment.
personalize.banner: Brand Kit 1 / futuristic modernism / luxe black-gold, safe margins, no cropped crest.

higher_reaction_role_limit.strategy: Use capacity for clean self-service creator disciplines + notification roles, not role clutter.

youtube_alerts.channel: creator-showcase or a dedicated media-drops channel
youtube_alerts.rule: Add only Founder-approved RMS/artist/community channels; Zapier must not duplicate these alerts.

twitch_alerts.rule: Use only for approved creator streams and RMS live programming.

higher_purge_limits.purpose: Emergency moderation and controlled cleanup only.
higher_purge_limits.boundary: No bulk deletion of official event records or support history.

temporary_channels.lifecycle: Auto-delete after event/session window with a conservative buffer.
temporary_channels.migration: Once Carl temporary rooms are verified, move VoiceMaster to fallback-only or retire it to reduce overlap.

immediate_autofeeds.owner: Carl-bot for Discord-native recurring reminders and approved content feeds only
immediate_autofeeds.rule: Zapier retains cross-platform/calendar/recap/failure-alert duties; no duplicate Discord routine message.

advanced_tagscript.settings: Delete invocation where supported; concise output; no secret or private data; leadership-only for event launchers.

starboard_customization.purpose: Surface meaningful creator/community moments without turning raw volume into professional status.

greetings.autorole: New Member / onboarding role until gate completion

moderation.staff_exemptions: Founder/mod roles only; use narrow channel exceptions instead of global bypass.

server_discovery.description: Ownership-first creator ecosystem for music, media, publishing, education, live listening, collaboration, creator showcases, games and professional growth.

Route to RESET Sound Stage entry
